capabilities: Collect every task in the vault into an agenda grouped by overdue, today, upcoming, later, no date and done today
Add tasks with plain-language dates, repeats and priorities that are parsed before saving
Render task fields as clickable chips in Live Preview and Reading view
Reschedule and complete tasks by clicking, dragging onto day headings, or with the keyboard, with undo
Draw existing ```tasks query blocks when the Tasks plugin is disabled
extras: Shows a one-time GitHub star request after updates (never on fresh installs or at start-up). Interface is available in English, Korean and Simplified Chinese. README states it is deliberately not a project manager: no boards, Gantt charts, time tracking or calendar sync.
intentEvidence: Doable keeps the format and changes the experience.
motivation: The author writes that Tasks is the most used task plugin for a reason, but seeing today means writing a query, dates require remembering an emoji, and every line ends in a row of symbols, so Doable keeps the format and changes the experience.
problem: The Tasks plugin keeps tasks as plain Markdown but seeing today's work means writing queries, and adding dates means typing emoji fields.

relations.evidence: Doable reads and writes exactly what the Tasks plugin does

summary: Agenda panel that gathers tasks from vault notes into overdue/today/upcoming lists, with plain-language task entry and readable date chips in Tasks format.
